status: SOURCE_ONLY; corrected R1-R4; execution HOLD K1-K4

layout.initialization: Parent initializes stop/epoch/allocator=0, positive invocation-unique session, version3; all three slots zero, only slot0 active. No added SAB or guest exposure.
layout.session: Parent-owned lifetime-unique positive signed32 session, refuse exhaustion; channel ownership authenticates authority, not number secrecy.

counters.operationSequence: Worker allocates1..128 once per header including denied calls/cache authorization/primitive print; no retry, queue overflow or wrap. No new seq until prior final ACK and FREE. Source acquisition is not a guest operation.
counters.frame: Both trusted peers use checked CAS on global frameAllocator to reserve1..4096 BEFORE frame encoding/copy. Reserved but unpublished frames burn capacity. Every REQUEST, RESPONSE or ACK is a frame, including empty credits/ACKs. No slot-state acquisition/FREE/RETIRE is a frame.
counters.predecessor: Each publication names exact last committed frame of that slot, including across reuse. Parent and Worker retain per-slot last state/phase/seq/frame plus bounded seen-frame bitsets. No repeated frame; no skipped per-slot predecessor. Global allocation order is NOT delivery order. No global largest-seen rejection across slots; inactive slots still refuse in this profile.
counters.admissionOrdinal: Parent-only1..129: at most128 admitted operations plus exactly one cutoff. Not a wire frame/sequence/wake counter. Denied/staged records consume seq but no effect ordinal.
counters.wakeEpoch: Parent-only checked increments1..8192 for response/FREE/stop notifications; no wrap. Reserve final emergency wake capacity while OPEN; reject further service before exhausting it. Permanent stop check prevents waiting at exhaustion.
counters.control: One unacknowledged Worker doorbell per slot, discharged by parent ownership CAS; at most4096 frame doorbells plus one READY and one terminal record (4098). Each encoded control <=256 bytes; control records carry no guest payload/raw reasons. Source/context bootstrap has its own reserved <=64KiB context and <=256KiB source, not a control bypass.
counters.source: One entry acquisition; <=256KiB UTF8. Source stream/fragments and their EOF are fully checked before guest run, with distinct sourceRead/stdinRead authority. No RPC grant turns source into data authority.

validation.ownData: Strict finite own-data exact keys and canonical encoding; no getters, symbols, inherited fields, extras, holes or coercion. Declared optional own-undefined allowed ONLY in typed FsError parent source extraction (path/syscall/dest), never wire/control/cache/options.
validation.numbers: Safe integer within field range; reject -0, NaN and infinities. Session1..2147483647, seq1..128, frame1..4096, predecessor0..4096, offset/total0..1048576, payloadLength0..65536.
validation.headers: Read header only after acquiring matching atomic state. Validate session/version/slot/reserved words, phase/tag, seq and predecessor before payload copy. Metadata <=8192 bytes; precharge fixed header/full frame/decode storage before reading. After cancel/exit do not inspect a peer-owned mutable payload.
validation.invalid: Any unexpected wire state/phase/tag/length/duplicate/stale/wrong-session/inactive slot closes admission as protocol failure and drains existing owners; do not attempt a corrective write or synthetic ACK. An inert old doorbell never grants authority.

request.rules: Path<=1024 UTF8 bytes, no NUL. Nonapplicable fields exactly null. Resolve namespace/path authority truthfully; lexical normalization is not confinement or symlink identity. JSON read/hit needs jsonModules AND dataRead. Module authorization validates fixed inventory only; write/read/output grants remain separate. Header-only requests have no upload.

response.rule: One terminal result only. Read consumes its full bounded source to EOF and flushes decoder before response metadata; failure sends no success prefix. Re-encoded replacement UTF8 response also <=1MiB, separately checked; raw cumulative read bytes are not replaced by encoded result length. Void only after actual write/output settlement. Parent operation cleanup may finish later. authorizeJson succeeds with void plus cacheKey; readText-json succeeds with text plus cacheKey established on that same operation. Guest hidden facade checks returned key on miss again before cache insertion; changed namespace authority refuses rather than installing under earlier key. Ordinary textfs never receives this private envelope.
response.cacheKey: Exactly null except successful authorizeJson/readText-json: own-data {namespace,path}, namespace is a bounded parent-issued handle truthfully bound to the invocation actual VFS namespace, path the authorized canonical virtual filename<=1024 UTF8 bytes. Entire metadata including key<=8192. Handle is NOT FileStat.identityScope or a disjoint-storage assertion; different clients do not prove distinct namespaces.

transitions.action: CAS FREE; allocate seq, precharge all request metadata/frame/write-string copies, then reserve frame; preserve previous committed frame. No concurrent publisher.
Encode validated header only; publish fields then Atomics.store state REQUEST; send bounded doorbell. Header is not payload body or effect admission.

CAS before copying; validate and reserve complete staging/result allowance and cleanup record. Invalid semantic grant yields denied without effect; malformed wire stops. For zero-byte writes skip upload, but still validate exact source encoding and enroll effect before mutation.

Only writes/output with remaining bytes. Reserve frame, empty payload, UPLOAD tag; offset equals bytes already copied, total equals header total. Implicit credit=min(65536,total-offset), always positive. Publish then notify independently of Worker callbacks.
CAS before checking credit, validate predecessor/seq/offset and empty payload. Precharged original primitive string and encoding/staging remain owned; no VFS effect.

Reserve frame before encoding/copy. Fill exactly credited positive byte length, total/offset unchanged, UPLOAD tag; chunks may split UTF8 sequences. Publish ACK and doorbell. No zero nonterminal chunks, overlap, overshoot or concurrent payload writer.

CAS then copy into precharged parent staging before next credit. Validate chunk and cumulative exact length; on final byte validate full UTF8 encoding/source and all route/grant/limits, then synchronously OPEN-check/enroll effect with immutable bytes. Incomplete/invalid/cutoff staging never calls VFS, even for wx or empty truncation. Read/hit operations validate complete header before their admission.

Only after full operation outcome or pre-effect semantic refusal. Validate/encode finite response in precharged <=8192 metadata; result total is separate from request upload total. Awaited sinks/stream completion are not inferred from transfer. Publish only if original ownership and OPEN gate still permit it.
CAS, precharge/result capacity already reserved, copy/validate full metadata. Zero text/void/error requires FINAL_ACK; positive text requires META_ACK.
Positive-text only, empty payload, result tag/total and offset0; reserve frame and publish. No upload bytes allowed in response ACKs.

CAS before validating ACK; copy next min(65536,remaining) positive response bytes, exact offset/total/tag and predecessor. No wait for guest microtask. Parent prebuffers bounded read result or independent producer completion; never holds a service lock across Worker ACK.

CAS then copy into precharged private assembly before ACK. Require positive exact expected length and full total before FINAL_ACK, else DATA_ACK. Reserve ACK frame; zero payload. Final decode/length/schema validation completes before FINAL_ACK; no bridge delivery assertion.

CAS and validate empty ACK; FREE only after actual operation settlement AND cooperative per-operation cleanup. Maintain outcome/handoff record outside slot. Worker may now return copied primitive/throw reconstructed local FS error; callback return itself still crosses bridge. Cleanup failure closes gate instead of FREE.

transitions.to: logical CLOSED; then RETIRED only after exit
transitions.action: Serialize cutoff; independent stop/wake when cancel/failure, never overwrite payload/state owned by Worker. Normal cutoff ceases service without aborting admitted VFS work. Confirm actual exit before transport retirement; await parent cleanup separately; no ACK required or invented, no session reuse.

CAS RESPONSE to WORKER_OWNED; validate complete zero-result metadata. total=offset=0, matching TEXT/VOID/FS_ERROR/UNSUPPORTED/DENIED tag, payloadLength=0. Precharge and reserve ACK frame; check predecessor/session/seq/stop. Write only header words1..8 and CAS state1->5; do NOT write/clear payload, reserved headers or inactive slots. Parent acquires ACK5->3, validates then waits independent operation cleanup before FREE3->0. ACK is not bridge delivery.

wait: Worker samples wakeEpoch, checks stop and exact expected state/seq/phase, then Atomics.wait on sampled epoch; recheck after every outcome/timeout. Parent notification is independent of blocked Worker listeners. Deadline remaining applies while OPEN; normal cutoff closes timer, not caller cancellation. Parent must never wait on an ACK to start/cancel other owned work; slots1/2 are refused, not serviced async. Worker rechecks permanent stop before payload encoding/copy, publication and return; a concurrent stop may race that local check, but parent CLOSED gate still forbids effects. Do not infer which cross-thread observation happened first. Cooperative parent operation/cleanup MUST NOT depend on guest progress, callback return or receiving a Worker ACK; otherwise this provider cannot qualify and ownership remains unsettled.

handoff.separation: Only first three permit slot FREE. They do not establish bridge delivered. Retain known rejection even after FREE in a bounded seq-indexed parent record.
handoff.candidate: Version3 adds deliveredSeq to existing terminal, no extra messages/frames/operations. Trusted interpreted facade receives primitive ordinary-bridge string, JSON parses it and constructs any guest Error first; hidden raw callback then records strictly contiguous postcopy marker. Terminal serializes actual stored marker count, not lastSeq/ACK as a proxy. Guest cannot name raw callback in the finite sealed lexical fixture. This source candidate must be independently qualified; it does not prove guest catch/exact fields or delivery upon cancellation. Undelivered typed outcomes retain originals.
handoff.blocker: K2 remains: public-entry closure unavailable, postcopy marker and guest catch unrun, no actual Shell priority/mapping integration. Without actual marker evidence known rejection is not delivered. ACK/terminal alone never establishes delivery.

terminal.rule: Trusted controller only; closes local guest gate after actual bound run settlement. Primitive print is a separately reserved controller output operation completed before terminal. Parent validates existing handoff evidence, then commits cutoff in one serialized turn; terminal message grants no delivery fact.

reconciliation: Parent admitted=settled+active; closed<=settled; keep exact output committed bytes and staged-discarded bytes. Termination/exit/close are separate flags. A late job checks original session/slot/seq/record and CLOSED before any SAB publication; always observe result/cleanup even when publication forbidden. No real operation or rejection erased by transport retirement.

controlSchemas.common: Exact ordered finite own data, no undefined/accessors/symbols/extras; reject -0/nonfinite/coercion. <=256 canonical UTF8 bytes. Sender and receiver both validate. One READY before RPC, one terminal, at most4096 doorbells; <=4098 controls; no added delivery messages.

namespaceSchema.namespace: positive safe integer1..128, no -0; invocation-local table bound by trusted parent to actual VFS authority
namespaceSchema.path: canonical authorized virtual path <=1024 UTF8 bytes, no NUL
namespaceSchema.lifetime: Never recycle handle within invocation; refuse unknown/changed handle or path at read completion. Source fixture uses handle1 for its sole development Map. Not FileStat.identityScope or disjointness. No cross-invocation/cache identity claim.
